text: {"reactions": [{"ad": "A1", "stopped": false, "understood": false, "believed": false, "why_not": "Image was just a solid turquoise colour with nothing on it, so I scrolled straight past - no reason to stop and I've seen Deliveroo ads a hundred times anyway.", "intent": "I wouldn't click as there's nothing to look at and I don't need a takeaway right now.", "intent_score": 1}, {"ad": "A2", "stopped": false, "understood": false, "believed": false, "why_not": "It says it's a men's t-shirt but the picture is of fishing lures in someone's hand, so it looks like a scam listing and I don't trust Temu tat.", "intent": "I wouldn't click because the product and image don't match and I don't need it.", "intent_score": 1}, {"ad": "A3", "stopped": false, "understood": false, "believed": false, "why_not": "Just a black screen with nothing to see and I don't believe in astrology or kundali readings, free chat just means they'll charge you after.", "intent": "I wouldn't click, not interested in fortune telling at all.", "intent_score": 1}, {"ad": "A4", "stopped": false, "understood": false, "believed": false, "why_not": "Says it's a stone cage gabion basket but shows a grey wicker bench, so I have no idea what they're actually selling and wouldn't trust the quality.", "intent": "I wouldn't click as it's confusing and I don't need garden walls.", "intent_score": 1}, {"ad": "A5", "stopped": false, "understood": false, "believed": false, "why_not": "It's all in Portuguese which I don't speak, and the image says ChatGPT for anxious attachment which sounds a bit dodgy and not for me.", "intent": "I wouldn't click because I can't understand it and I'm not looking for an app like that.", "intent_score": 1}], "preferred": "A1"}
